info.title: Locus — US property & public-records context
info.description: Locally curated request catalog for x402 MCP. Not a vendor-published OpenAPI document.

post.summary: Historical air quality and satellite-observed smoke
post.description: EPA AQS annual monitors, exact-point NOAA HMS satellite smoke days, and separate CDC county modeled PM2.5 when a year lacks nearby AQS PM2.5. For past air context. Missing mirror years are disclosed, not treated as clean air; no source-fire attribution or property safety finding.

address.description: Optional US street address or place; provide instead of latitude+longitude.

latitude.description: Optional decimal latitude; provide with longitude to skip address geocoding.

longitude.description: Optional decimal longitude; provide with latitude to skip address geocoding.

yearsBack.description: Calendar-year lookback, 1-10 years; default 5. The response discloses which requested years are actually ingested.

radiusKm.description: Nearby AQS monitor search radius in kilometers; default 50, max 150. HMS smoke uses exact point-in-polygon.

schema.description: US street address or latitude+longitude, plus an optional 1-10 calendar-year lookback and AQS monitor radius. NOAA HMS history is exact point-in-polygon.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

post.summary: Cited property-value appeal deadline calculator
post.description: Cited property-value appeal deadline for owners in a covered state; returns the rule, statute, source, computed dates when inputs support them, caveats, and verify-next, for a notice date or protest window. Returns the same records as locus_appeal_window. Use this when your client can only call paid x402 routes. Use locus_appeal_window instead when you can call Locus free tools (REST tools/call or MCP).

noticeDate.description: Optional ISO date YYYY-MM-DD from the owner's notice; use the mailed, delivered, printed, or publication date named by the returned rule.

year.description: Tax year; defaults to the current year.

locality.description: Optional locality row: nyc_class1, nyc_other, nassau, or philadelphia. Other localities return coverage guidance.

propertyClass.description: Optional published property class. NYC class 1 selects the nyc_class1 row when locality is not supplied.

revaluationYear.description: NJ only: true when a municipal-wide revaluation or reassessment was implemented.

countyExtended.description: WA only: true when the county adopted the 60-day notice period.

state.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation or full state name, for example TX or Texas.

address.description: Full US address used to resolve the governing state, county, and locality.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

post.summary: Area reported-crime context
post.description: Reported area incidents for an address from covered municipal feeds, with counts and categories where wired; elsewhere links to NC SBI, SC SLED, or FBI CDE. Returns the same records as locus_area_incidents. Use this when your client can only call paid x402 routes. Use locus_area_incidents instead when you can call Locus free tools (REST tools/call or MCP).

address.description: Required street address used to scope area reported-crime context, e.g. '123 Oak Park Dr, Cary, NC 27519'.

radiusMeters.description: Optional radius in meters for point feeds when available; default 1000, max 5000.

lookbackDays.description: Optional lookback window in days for point feeds; default 365, max 1825.

includeSurveyContext.description: Optional boolean; include BJS NCVS caveats/context. Default true. National methodology context only, never a local estimate.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

post.summary: Assessment position, appeal deadline, and filing guide
post.description: Same-roll assessment-uniformity percentile, state appeal-deadline rule, and local or state filing guide for an owner. Shows where the assessment sits among similar properties on the same roll, with deadline and filing steps. No dollar figure, value endorsement, or recommendation to appeal.

address.description: US street address for the subject property.

noticeDate.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the assessment notice was mailed; sharpens the appeal-deadline computation where the state's rule needs it.

noticeYear.description: Tax year of the assessment notice; defaults to the current year.

radiusMeters.description: Optional same-roll comparison radius; default 400m, max 1200m.

schema.description: US street address, optionally a notice date and tax year. No dollar figure is accepted; Locus never authors, estimates, or endorses a value.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

post.summary: Before-you-sign due-diligence bundle (one address)
post.description: Parcel, local-change, and bill or ordinance records for one street address after free lane preflight. After settlement or seller-escrow, parcelFacts may show the cited assessor owner-of-record for the same exact parcel, not a contact. Optional context frames output, never changes access.

address.description: Flexible US street address for the property under consideration, e.g. '200 Fayetteville St, Raleigh, NC 27601'. Include city/state or ZIP when possible; this bundle is address-first, not county-only.

context.description: Optional caller context used only to prioritize and frame the cited output; it never changes data access.

followUp.description: Optional follow-up question answered only from the bundle's fetched evidence.

schema.description: Flexible US street address of the property. Optional context and followUp fields frame the cited output but never change data access. Include city/state or ZIP when possible. Coverage is checked before any charge.

default.description: Provider response; response schema is not modeled in this local catalog.

post.summary: Large-site Sentinel-2 imagery pair
post.description: Two dated Copernicus Sentinel-2 images for WGS84 bbox and ordered beforeDate/afterDate. Use locus_satellite_area_prepare for addresses. Area 1-100 sq km; sides >=500m, aspect <=8:1. Metadata by default; includeImagery inlines PNGs. No change detection; source failure is free. REST-only.

areaLabel.description: Optional non-person site label. It is presentation only and is not sent to the imagery provider.

bbox.description: Requires bbox [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 longitude/latitude; no address input. Area 1-100 km², each side at least 500 m, aspect ratio at most 8:1. Surrounding-area context, not individual-building imagery.

beforeDate.description: Anchor date for the earlier composite.

afterDate.description: Anchor date for the later composite; must be later than beforeDate.

includeImagery.description: Inline the two validated PNG renders as base64. Off by default: a 512 px pair pushes the response past 128 KB and breaks naive JSON capture. The dated catalogue metadata, byte sizes, and pixel dimensions are always returned.
